natural.label_policy: Evaluator-only; adapter has no test_labels attribute or argument
natural.native_counter_note: Only diagnostic-label reads/increments removed; official selection totals and queue counters unchanged
natural.id_semantics: Window ID = zero-based start in raw native test; batch scores all available at last window end. Latency = commit batch last window ID minus selected window ID.

risks.score_before_adapt: Runtime PASS at native batch granularity, not pointwise within batch
risks.min_samples: Runtime: all hard/moderate commits >=16, hard before moderate; pending tail not flushed
risks.final_batch: Runtime: 138 windows; true offset 23552, native iter*len(scores)=12696. Selected ID23629 misindexed as12773. Both labels happen normal; aggregate anomaly count unchanged for this run.
risks.official_counters: Admission counts, not committed counts: moderate9747 selected vs9746 committed; 1 pending
risks.moderate_mask: Static verified: Q1-Q3 test mask overwritten by scores<threshold; reference remains validation Q1-Q3. Unchanged.
risks.use_fpm_false: Static verified: early return skips iter increment; NOT executed as alternate detector configuration.
risks.representation: Static: get_representations applies sana_in then frozen encoder and L2 normalization; representations can change with SANA.
risks.normalization: Static native loader: split raw train80/20 first, StandardScaler.fit_transform(train80%), transform val/test. No online scaler. TRAIN_RATIO>=1 fallback uses test as val but inactive.
risks.optimizer: Actual native SGD settings preserved; configured gradient-clip flag not applied by adapt loop (no clip call). No correction.
risks.scope: Runtime audit only SMD_1-8 alpha5 seed0; other machine/alpha audits N/A after C1 stop

label_permutation.note: Permutation is evaluator-only after algorithm execution by design; no evaluator labels enter isolated adapter. This does not certify the untouched official label-passing API.

native_overlay_parity.native_intermediate_trajectory: Not instrumented; do not claim every native intermediate state was compared
native_overlay_parity.counters: Diagnostic anomaly counters intentionally suppressed in isolated overlay; algorithm/selection totals preserved
